app.description: {@link App} this node pool is intended for.

title:
A logical grouping of nodes. Nodes for a given node pool are homogeneous to one another and an individual node does
not change during its life cycle. A node pool should not need to be explicitly configured and started by a user, but
can be automated by the C3 Platform by optionally annotating a given {@link Action} with a node pool.

@see App.NodePool.Config
name: App.NodePool
